description: This file defines the Thumb controller class for OpenCart, responsible for generating the data needed to display product thumbnails, including links to cart, wishlist, compare, and reviews, and rendering the thumbnail view.

classes.name: Thumb
classes.description: Controller class for handling product thumbnail display, including preparing data and rendering the thumbnail view.
